Combining those labels with the 135 local (4,4,4,3) cells produces 45 unordered line triples, each repeated on three sheets, recovering the full GQ(4,2) quotient. The huge S135 symmetry of the local dual-shell design collapses to S3^45 semidirect the 51840-element GQ automorphism group.
